subject: general
question: Which of the following European power is first to come to India for trade?
solution:
• 
 
Portuguese were the first Europeans to come to India for trade.

 
 
• 
 
Vasco da Gama was the first European to reach India by sea in 1498 at Calicut.

 
 
• 
 
Portuguese were the first to come and the last to leave India.

 
 
• 
 
They finally left in 1961 (Goa Liberation).

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Dutch were the second European traders to come to India in 1602.

 
 
• 
 
They established the Dutch East India Company (VOC).

 
 
 
 
• 
 
English came in 1600 but began trade in India in 1613.

 
 
• 
 
English East India Company was formed in 1600.

 
 
• 
 
First factory at Surat in 1613.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
French came in 1664.

 
 
• 
 
French East India Company was established in 1664.
